NAME: Calibration Comment
DESCRIPTION: Comments about calibration values

NAME: Barometric Attenuation Length
DESCRIPTION: Barometric attenuation length for pressure correction

NAME: N0 Mod
DESCRIPTION: Count rate over dry soil under reference conditions

NAME: N Max
DESCRIPTION: Maximum neutron count threshold

NAME: N Min
DESCRIPTION: Minimum neutron count threshold

NAME: Probe Effective Depth 1m
DESCRIPTION: Effective depth in cm, at 1 metre from probe, on day of calibration

NAME: Probe Effective Depth 200m
DESCRIPTION: Effective depth in cm, at 200 metres from probe, on day of calibration

NAME: Ref Bulk Density
DESCRIPTION: Mean Bulk Density at most applicable effective depth (from lab analysis of soil samples)

NAME: Ref Bulk Density STD
DESCRIPTION: Standard deviation of Bulk Density (from lab analysis of soil samples)

NAME: REF C0
DESCRIPTION: Neutron Intensity correction factor

NAME: Ref CTS Mod Corr
DESCRIPTION: Reference counts for COSMOS Moderated probe

NAME: Ref Lattice Water
DESCRIPTION: Mean Lattice and bound water (from lab analysis of soil samples)

NAME: Ref Lattice Water STD
DESCRIPTION: Standard deviation of Lattice and bound water (from lab analysis of soil samples)

NAME: Ref Q0
DESCRIPTION: Water vapour correction factor

NAME: Ref SOC
DESCRIPTION: Estimated mean Soil Organic Carbon (from lab analysis of soil samples)

NAME: Ref SOC STD
DESCRIPTION: Estimated Standard deviation of Soil Organic Carbon (from lab analysis of soil samples)

NAME: Ref Soil Moisture
DESCRIPTION: Reference soil moisture from lab analysis on day of calibration

NAME: Ref Soil Comment
DESCRIPTION: Comment on soil properties from lab analysis of field samples

NAME: Sampling Start Datetime
DESCRIPTION: Start datetime of soil sampling for lab analysis

NAME: Sampling End Datetime
DESCRIPTION: End datetime of soil sampling for lab analysis

NAME: Priority
DESCRIPTION: A relative priority number for the annotated object.

NAME: Catchment Area Size
DESCRIPTION: The size of the catchment area in square kilometres

NAME: Operator Facility ID
DESCRIPTION: The operator-assigned identifier of the annotated facility
